title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-dztx: rfc9529_signature_trace_vectors test passes 3 args to transcript_4 (now takes 2)
description:
## Location

`rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:1691`

## Problem

Commit cc2b1533db changed `transcript_4` to take only 2 parameters (`th_3` and `ciphertext_3`) — dropping the `cred` parameter. The test `rfc9529_signature_trace_vectors` at line 1691 was NOT updated and still calls:
```rust
transcript_4(&th_3, &plaintext_3, &credential_i).unwrap()
```

This is a build-breaking compile error (E0061: wrong number of arguments) when tests are compiled.

## Additional spec issue

The test expects `th_4 = ad002457080da9a5e7a942030ca302f5cc9f77ba8124a49ba560d168b5b6f26d` which is computed as H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_I) per RFC 9529 §3.1 and RFC 9528 §4.1.3. The new `transcript_4` computes H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3) without CRED_I. Even after fixing the arg count, the expected value won't match.

RFC 9528 §4.1.3 states: TH_4 = H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_I). Both the bead `project-LICHEN-worker6-61fd` (which claimed CRED_I shouldn't be included) and this commit (which removed it AND switched to CIPHERTEXT_3) deviate from the RFC.

## Fix needed

1. Restore `cred` parameter to `transcript_4` to compute H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_I)
2. Update the responder path to pass `pending.plaintext` (PLAINTEXT_3) not `pending.ciphertext_3` (CIPHERTEXT_3)
3. Update line 1691 test to match

Alternatively, if CIPHERTEXT_3 without CRED_I is a deliberate deviation, update the expected `th_4` value in the test and document the spec deviation.
